title: American Express® Business Gold Card

body_markdown:
The American Express Business Gold is a top contender for business owners looking to maximize their rewards on everyday expenses. Tailored to adapt to your company’s spending habits, the card offers a remarkable 4X Membership Rewards® points on the two categories where your business spent the most per billing cycle, from a diverse selection of 6 category options:


Purchases at US media providers for advertising in select media (online, TV, radio)


U.S. purchases made from electronic goods retailers and software & cloud system providers


U.S. purchases at restaurants, including takeout and delivery


U.S. purchases at gas stations


Transit purchases including trains, taxicabs, rideshare services, ferries, tolls, parking, buses, and subways


Monthly wireless telephone service charges made directly from a wireless telephone service provider in the U.S.


While your top 2 categories may change, you will earn 4X points on the first $150,000 in combined purchases from these categories each calendar year (then 1X thereafter). Only the top 2 categories each billing cycle will count towards the $150,000 cap.


[Learn more](https://bit.ly/roame-amex-biz-gold) about this card today!
